title: R. al-Muḥammadiyya ('On the Name Muḥammad')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 139b-45a), flagged with his asterisk as probably a date of transcription rather than composition (p.79). The K. al-Mafāḥiṣ (823/1420) refers to a R. al-Muḥammadiyya at f. 76a, but that text was revised in 828/1425.

manuscript: 3 items listed: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 139b-45a (5 Shawwāl 828/20 Aug 1425); a Majlis copy cited with no shelfmark (32/238); Sipahsālār MS 2930/3 (Abarquh, 23 Ṣafar 845/1441).
summary: A lettrist treatment of the name Muḥammad, dealing with how the rulings of the Muḥammadan law were derived without reference to the intellectual sciences.
